publicacion.titulo: Official publication of the call rules
publicacion.ayuda_boton: Help with publishing the call rules
publicacion.ayuda: 1. Find the recruitment process in the list. 2. Select Record publication and copy the notice details exactly as they appear in the bulletin or on the notice board. 3. If you made a mistake, select Correct on the same row: the new record replaces the previous one.
publicacion.no_disponible_texto: Recording the publication of the call rules is not enabled in this installation. If you need it, contact IT.
publicacion.denegada: Your current access does not allow you to record publications. If it should, contact the person in charge of permissions.
publicacion.error: The list of recruitment processes could not be loaded. Select Retry. If the problem continues, contact IT.
publicacion.vacio: There are no recruitment processes whose call rules you can record. If you expected one, ask the person in charge.
publicacion.incompleta: The list shows only some of the recruitment processes. If you cannot find yours, contact IT.
publicacion.ver_anuncio: View notice (opens in a new tab)
publicacion.formulario_titulo: Record the publication of the call rules
publicacion.formulario_titulo_corregir: Correct the publication of the call rules
publicacion.formulario_corrige: The new record will replace the one registered on {fecha}.
publicacion.medio_bop_granada: Official Bulletin of the Province of Granada
publicacion.medio_boja: Official Gazette of the Regional Government of Andalusia
publicacion.error_medio: Choose where the call rules were published.
publicacion.error_boletin_numero: Enter the bulletin issue number: a whole number between 1 and 99999.
publicacion.error_anuncio_ref: Enter the notice reference using letters, numbers, dots, slashes or hyphens, without spaces. Up to 80 characters.
publicacion.error_fecha_publicacion: Enter a valid date that is not later than today.
publicacion.error_direccion: Enter a link starting with https://, or leave the field empty.
publicacion.resguardo_repetida: This publication was already recorded with the same details. It has not been recorded twice.
publicacion.error_solicitud: The details were not accepted. Check them and select Record publication again.
publicacion.error_version: The call rules for this recruitment process changed while you were filling in the form. The list has been refreshed: check the process and record it again.
publicacion.error_conflicto: Another record already exists for this recruitment process. The list has been refreshed: check it and, if needed, select Correct.
publicacion.error_no_confirmado: We could not confirm whether the publication was recorded. Select Record publication again without changing the details: it will not be recorded twice.
publicacion.error_envio: The record could not be sent. Check your connection and select Record publication again without changing the details.
publicacion.error_servicio: Publication records are not available right now. Try again later. If the problem continues, contact IT.
